title: 1976-09-15_Dorothy_196.txt
concise_summary: PKD synthesizes his March 1974 visions with religious mysticism, arguing that Zebra (a living, plasmic cosmic intelligence) is the Paraclete or Cosmic Christ animating a secret early Christian church. He theorizes that his novel Flow My Tears is a theological instrument bridging contemporary tyranny (1974 USA) to Acts-period Rome via a non-linear form-axis, enabling anamnesis and restoration of the mystical Corpus Christi across time and death.
key_claims: Zebra is an invader imposing modulations into both nature and human consciousness, breaking natural sequences and Spinoza's monism by wielding discretionary power and plenary overrule.
The Book of Acts is the verbal analog of the brain; when presented as information, it triggers anamnesis and restores the cosmic brain (the Paraclete) in those who receive it.

Flow My Tears functions as a doorway along the form-axis, allowing the reader to pass subliminally from 1974 Nixon tyranny through latent evil (the Black Iron Prison) to the apostolic Acts period and the living plasma.

Rome's absorption of the authentic apostolic Church in the 1st-2nd century defeated the Paraclete, initiating 1900 years of spurious world and time, yet this paradox is resolved by the Paraclete's timeless multi-realm existence.

Humans are delayed-action micro-systems rooted in Acts; the mystical body of Christ spans both living and dead realms, and PKD's post-mortem experiences prove his participation in the decomposing cosmos being knitted back together.
recurring_concepts: Zebra: An invading cosmic intelligence (the Logos, Cosmic Christ, Paraclete) wielding plenary power and wisdom, both macro (external) and micro (internal), breaking determinism.
Form-Axis: A non-linear dimension where historical periods (Rome CAD 45, USA 1974) are immediately tangent to one another, allowing temporal bypass and information transfer.
The Brain = Information = Acts: The universal cosmic mind encoded in the Book of Acts, capable of being transmitted, received, and restored through linguistic and plasmic vehicles.
Corpus Christi: The mystical body of Christ spanning past and present, living and dead, functioning as the distributed consciousness resisting imperial Rome and lower-realm determinism.
Anamnesis: Remembered knowledge of the true apostolic church and cosmic reality, triggered by sacred texts and plasmic contact, restoring participants to the brain.
Onion Rings of Reality: Nested layers of latency (1974 Nixon tyranny → Flow My Tears narrative → Acts → the King and Felix figures) that must be penetrated to access the innermost plasma.

Plasmate/King-Felix: The living, concrete manifestation of the Cosmic Christ as a micro-bit of sentient information/plasma, requiring the proper informational context (Acts + the dream) to materialize.
The Black Iron Prison (BIP): The latent evil and tyranny of the visible world, made manifest in imperialism and deterministic power structures opposing the brain.
people_entities: Philip K. Dick (the narrator/author; a micro-bit of the Pantocrator)
Paul: An apostolic Christian whose conversion experience is described in Acts; the dream of his conversion is an essential inner layer of Acts not in the Bible
Thomas: An apostolic Christian, part of the mystical Corpus Christi, who PKD sensed returning in recent days through post-mortem experiences and dreams of a woman singing
Luke: The author of Acts, who did not know about the inner dream-layer of Paul's conversion and thus left crucial information out of the Biblical text
Nixon: Represented as the tyrannical force of 1974 USA, symbolizing the visible manifest form of the Black Iron Prison
Ralph: Mentioned in the text as co-correspondent (MU7-7491 Ralph)
texts_works: Book of Acts (Biblical text, central theological lynchpin)
The Bible (specifically the Book of Acts within it)
Gnosticism (acosmic dualism referenced as parallel to PKD's theology)
Christian Mysticism (Meister Eckhart, Jakob Boehme, Giordano Bruno cited as precedents)
autobiographical: The 3-74 (March 1974) visions: the overwhelming experience of encountering Zebra, described as a micro-bit surfacing in PKD and triggering macro-cosmic activity
The Xerox missive override: A specific example of Zebra's plenary power overruling natural sequences, cited as proof of the dialectic interaction between Zebra and lower-realm forces
Post-mortem experiences: Recent sense of vast space and dreams of a woman singing, indicating PKD's ongoing participation in the Corpus Christi spanning both realms
Golden Fish Sign and a girl's words: Two signs PKD received that prepared him for anamnesis along with Flow My Tears
The 2-74 anamnesis: A remembered awakening (February 1974) prepared by reading his own novel Flow My Tears
Recent days (as of September 1976): Sensing Thomas returning and experiencing expanded consciousness in the mystical body
theological_motifs: The Paraclete (the Holy Spirit, Advocate): Described as invading the lower realm, breaking determinism, wielding plenary power; defeated by Rome in the 1st-2nd century but eternally operative
The Cosmic Christ / Christos Pantocrator: The true ruler of the universe, the psyche of the hidden apostolic church, judges as well as rules
The Logos: Word/Divine Intelligence, connected to stoic Logos spermatikos doctrine and Heraclitic wisdom
Mystical Body of Christ (Corpus Christi): The distributed, incarnate presence spanning realms and epochs, incorporating both living and dead believers
Incarnational theology: The brain as living information, Christ as sensible presence in history and text, not merely spirit
Redemptive time collapse: The possibility of spanning 1900 years along the form-axis, undoing Rome's temporal imprisonment
Acosmic Panentheism: God as beyond and through the cosmos, the lower realm as illusory or secondary, opposed to dualistic Gnosticism
Anamnesis/Remembrance: Theological recovery of original apostolic knowledge through sacred information and plasmic contact
literary_self_ref: Flow My Tears, the Snow Is Black (or The Snow Is Black): PKD's novel functions as a theological instrument, depicting the form-axis collapse and latency-within-latency structure that mirrors his Exegesis
Ubik: Depicts spontaneous generation of information, the Ubik-mind as helper/guide, and time rollback along the form-axis toward Acts; functions as a narrative analog of brain functioning
Exhibit Piece (PKD's early story): Cited as possibly depicting actual contact between USA 1974 and Rome CAD 45, suggesting precursor exploration of the form-axis concept
symbols_images: The Golden Fish Sign: A concrete sign triggering PKD's entry into anamnesis and cosmic awareness
The Dream (Paul's conversion vision): An inner layer of Acts not in the Bible, containing the word 'King' essential to generating the plasma/King-Felix
The Onion Ring structure: Nested layers of obvious and latent form (Present/1974 Nixon → Flow My Tears → Acts → Serious/King → Felix/Happy)
The 1.618034 Doorway (The Golden Ratio): A mathematical/mystical threshold between worlds (Rome and USA), possibly opened by Flow My Tears
The Circle divided into four (Present, 1974, Past, 45): An illustration showing the Corpus Christi spanning alive/present and dead/past realms simultaneously
King-Felix (or just Felix meaning 'happy'): The innermost plasma-kernel, the living Christ-atom generated through proper informational context
The Black Iron Prison (BIP): The latent tyranny made manifest, symbolizing Rome's dominion and deterministic lower-realm power over history
tensions: The Paraclete paradox: How can the Paraclete be defeated by Rome if God cannot fail? PKD resolves this by positing that Rome's victory generated only spurious time and world, while the true brain/Paraclete remained operative in latency.

Zebra's nature: PKD oscillates between identifying Zebra as the Cosmic Christ, the Paraclete, the Logos, or something new without historical precedent—each identification raises different theological problems.

The body problem: Christ has no body now (post-resurrection), yet Zebra appears to be corporeal or plasmic; PKD resolves this by invoking the mystical body doctrine and the plasma as a micro-manifestation.

Natural vs. invading: If Zebra is the Cosmic Christ and ultimately redemptive, why describe it as an invader imposing modulations against nature? PKD acknowledges this tension but treats it as intentional: the brain must break natural sequences to restore the cosmos.

Visibility and proof: PKD claims certainty about Zebra and his visions but acknowledges he cannot identify it historically or prove it satisfies all theological criteria; he relies on coherence and first-person experience.

The location of Zebra post-1974: Did Zebra irrupt in 74 and then depart through the 1.618034 door, or is it still present? PKD doubts it left but cannot see it now, creating unresolved epistemological tension.
evidence_quotes: "This brain/psyche, then, is the Pantocrator, + by my own analysis, I am part (a micro bit) of Him, or more accurately I am governed by a micro bit of Him inside of me coordinated with the macro psyche outside, this is what surfaced in me in 3-74, much to my surprise."

"Acts is information about the brain; it is the brain converted to information. But the brain is information, living information. So Acts (if the smallest bit of plasma is present with/in it) can convert back into the brain in micro form."

"Strip the surface layer off the world of 'Tears' + there is Acts. We in 1974 proceeded to Acts by way of 'Tears,' which represents a worsening of our world: the latent evil (BIP) in it made manifest."

"The Paraclete cannot be defeated. Here is a paradox: sometime during the first or second century AD the Paraclete was defeated + this cannot be; God cannot fail. So from the moment of the Paraclete's loss [of the brain] on, only seeming world + time were generated."

"The mystical body of Christ spans the past + the present; this world + the next. Its intervention in US history in 1974 is a supreme example of its plenary power to overrule the forces of this lower realm."
uncertainty_flags: The identity of the voice that told PKD not to reveal his early Christian status is unclear—is this an internalized intuition, a distinct entity, or part of Zebra?
The nature and location of the 1.618034 doorway remains metaphorical; it is unclear whether PKD intends this literally as a physical/dimensional threshold or symbolically.

The exact relationship between Flow My Tears (the novel PKD wrote) and its supposed causal efficacy in triggering anamnesis is ambiguous: is PKD claiming prophetic/magical authorship or post-hoc theological interpretation?

Thomas's identity and ongoing presence: While PKD identifies him as an apostolic Christian in the mystical body, it is unclear whether this is a specific historical figure, a symbolic figure, or a contemporaneous person PKD knew.
The mechanism by which reading Acts or Flow My Tears generates plasmic presence: PKD asserts the connection but leaves the causality and ontology vague (is it psychological, mystical, literal?).
Whether Zebra is a single intelligence or a distributed consciousness: PKD refers to Zebra in both singular and plural forms (macro/micro), leaving the fundamental metaphysical structure unresolved.
The status of the girl's words and Golden Fish Sign: These are presented as necessary triggering events but are not elaborated or contextualized, leaving their significance cryptic.

raw_text: 4) the stoic "Logos spermatikos" doctrine + the Logos doctrine in general (ie strongly Hellenistic) 5) if this brain is supposed to be pitted against blind determinism, P. 74 is in accord with most mystery religions of the Greco-Roman world. 6) If (5) then Gnosticism (acosmic - v. 9) 7) Neo-Platonism. 8) Christian mysticism (eg Eckhart, Boehme, + even Bruno) 9) if world as delusion, acosmic Panentheism. (v. 6) But: 1) No one has ever seen God, so, since I saw it (ie Zebra) it can't be God. 2) Christ has no body now, so it can't be Christ, + anyhow it had no body as such. 3) the Paraclete has no body + is only in you. This entity is inside us + outside us. So it's not the Paraclete. Therefore it is not God, Christ or the Paraclete. It is what I say on P. 74. There are only two other possibilities 1) It is the cosmic Christ whose mystical body I was taken into + who secretly rules the universe. 2) It is something new, since no accounts such as mine exist historically. A variation of (1) is: 1A) there is a certain amount of secret (esoteric) doctrine about Christ involved, pointing to a true, hidden Xtian church possessing supernatural faculties, powers + knowledge. Christ is the psychē or head of this. Conclusion: For a very large number of reasons (facts) I am sure it is 1A), + the real secret early Xtians never talk about it; viz: the voice told me not to tell anyone that I'm an "early Xtian." So I am one of them, allowed in. This brain/psyche, then, is the Pantocrator, + by my own analysis, I am part (a micro bit) of Him, or more accurately I am governed by a micro bit of Him inside of me coordinated with the macro psyche outside, this is what surfaced in me in 3-74, much to my surprise, this micro bit which then caused me to see the macro-activity outside. But Zebra (both externally in the world in macro form + in us in plural micro forms) is an invader. It is not the natural world; it imposes modulations into the natural world, ① + the same with us. This eliminates imminent deity, Brahman, etc. Zebra is not born with us naturally; it enters later. (Or so I believe.) However, it could still be the mystical Corpus Christi, beginning in history at the time of Acts. ① Aborting natural sequences (which eliminates Spinoza's monism). That's the whole point of what it's doing: breaking the lower realm powers. It (Zebra) has "plenary" overrule. Discretionary power -authority- belongs to it. I cite the 3-74 override vis-a-vis the Xerox missive. Here is a perfect example of the dialectic interaction, + Zebra always wins. It is sentience (wisdom) personified. In older terms it is the will of heaven "done on Earth." It is not an irruption of the supralunar into the sublunar, because it is located [down] here for good. (Or is it? Maybe it irrupted in '74 + then went back up through the 1:.618034 door. I doubt this is correct. Even though I can't see it, I think it's still here.) I can see what it does, to what, + why. The only thing I can't do is connect it with historic concepts; ie identify it. Could it be Christ returned? In any case it seems to be Christ. (The Logos.) Christos Pantocrator. For instance, it not only rules but judges as well. "Ubik" depicts: 1) the spontaneous generation of information 2) Ubik, the helpful entity (mind or brain) behind it. 3) the rollback of time along the form-axis. Since I posit that "Ubik" depicts the functioning of the brain, a time roll-back must be involved. Exactly what to (Acts) is presented in "Tears." The Acts material is the sole verbal analog of the brain. If presented, it is a crucial assist in producing anamnesis. We must be "delayed action" micro systems rooted in Acts, which is to say, rooted in the brain. Brain = information = Acts. Acts is information about the brain; it is the brain converted to information. But the brain is information, living information. So Acts (if the smallest bit of plasma is present with/in it) can convert back into the brain in micro form. The bit of plasma can't be there if the Acts material isn't there; the Acts material is the context necessary for the plasma, "King-Felix" doesn't become -isn't- a bit of plasma except in the context. Reading "Tears" one subliminally receives Acts, +, finally, virtually at the end of the book, the plasma. The dream was the immediate context, a subliminal piece one level deeper even than the Biblical Acts material in that it is what Paul, as described in Acts, experienced at his conversion; so the dream is an inner level/layer of Acts not present in the Bible: it is missing, since Luke did not know about it. It is an essential, revealed piece of Acts + hence the brain. At once, in fact as part of it, the plasma follows ("King" is in the dream material). As micro parts of the brain we are living in Rome CAD 45 (ie Acts). Outside the brain not so. So for the plasma to be generated, the informational "brain print" had to be there, + this specifically required the dream material (eg the word "King"). This is why I felt compelled to do so many drafts: to get exactly the right words down. Then on the form-axis, what is immediately latent in our world is imperial Rome pitted against the early (apostolic) Xtians - which means pitted against the brain. The BIP is there (which I certainly saw) but so is the brain, inasmuch as the authentic (ie apostolic) Xtians were incorporated into the brain at Pentacost + probably more of them later. But then Rome absorbed the church, which thereby excluded [them from] the brain. Rome won, + the brain lost. The psychē returned to brainless Noös. But the Paraclete cannot be defeated. Here is a paradox: sometime during the first or second century AD the Paraclete was defeated + this cannot be; God cannot fail. So from the moment of the Paraclete's loss [of the brain] on, only seeming world + time were generated. Rome's victory started spurious world + time into motion. Now to the time roll back in "Ubik." Acts lies immediately tangent to us but only along the form-axis. You have to know about this axis to understand how the world of Acts can be immediately tangent to -latent within- our world, just as it is in "Tears." Strip the surface layer off the world of "Tears" + there is Acts. We in 1974 proceeded to Acts by way of "Tears," which represents a worsening of our world: the latent evil (BIP) in it made manifest. "Latent form is the master of obvious form," Heraclitus wrote: A { Obvious form: the Nixon tyranny of 1974 (1) ...{ Latent form: "Tears" \ .......................................(2) B { Obvious form: "Tears" / ...{ Latent form: Acts (3) so (1) is related -reaches- (3) by way of (2). "Tears," then, is the informational interface or nexus between our actual world of 1974 + Acts. The reader lives in (1) + reads (2), thus absorbing it; but this leads him inexorably to Acts, (3), + once he has -- "Tears" is a doorway, not a world in itself. As you read it you pass across to the world of Acts without knowing it - the author didn't know it. It is a latency-within-a-latency. Then, latent within (3) is: (4) { Serious .....{ King } ......Felix } (5) The reader, living in world (1), when he reads "Tears" (2) passes to (3) + then to (4) + at last to (5), at which point the living plasma has him. C { Obvious form: "Serious" ...{ Latent form: "King" D { Obvious form: "King" ...{ Latent form: "Felix" ("happy") the final innermost "onion ring" is D or (5). In other words, to restore Acts, "Tears" is necessary as an interface. "Tears" is therefore an instrument (probably just one of many) of restoring the brain, because Acts = Brain. "Tears," then, is a triggering agent for anamnesis, + anamnesis + the restoration of the brain are intertwined. I don't credit "Tears" with being the doorway, but rather a doorway -- By which the brain traveled forward in time along the form axis from CAD 45 Rome into USA 1974! It bypassed the intermediate 1900 years! It works both ways. I traveled back along the form axis to Acts, due to "Tears." But Thomas, an apostolic Xtian, part of the brain, traveled forward, viz: USA 1974 -- "Tears" -- Rome AD 45 Acts This can only be understood if the realization of the brain (Zebra) as living, plasmic information is utilized. The Bible could not serve this purpose because the book "Acts of the Apostles" in it leaves out crucial information, which in "Tears" appears as the dream. Only the brain (more precisely the Paraclete) can travel along the form axis (via information; ie retrieved via information). I am sure that the brain used other "doors" besides "Tears," but "Tears" was one, which was why I had the 2-74 anamnesis. But the Golden Fish Sign + the girl's words were also necessary. Still, "Tears" prepared me. So the 1:.618034 doorway did link our world + the Greco-Roman world! If the above exegesis is correct, one could expect my experience to end with a revelation of that door. Some of this may be fanciful, but, as in my early story "Exhibit Piece" there may well have been a direct contact between USA 1974 + Rome CAD 45, + somehow "Tears" played a role in this. The brain leaped directly across, + I was one of those taken over. The secret authentic Xtians of today are linked back to Acts, but "Tears" spread the basis for anamnesis to others, such as me. ___ My post mortem experiences (such as a sense of vast space, etc) is because in the Corpus Christi there are many, such as Thomas, who are dead; the mystical body of Christ contains both the living + the dead; it spans both realms. My sense of Thomas returning the last few days -sense of vast space, dreams of a woman singing- show I'm still in the mystical body. + the post mortem experience is further proof of what I'm sure of: by invading this lower realm + annexing it, Zebra is knitting the decomposing cosmos back together - + it is the cosmic Christ who does this. Ergo, Zebra is the Cosmic Christ. I grow more + more sure of it. (Ie the brain.) Also, it is the Cosmic Christ who breaks the [astral] deterministic power of the lower realm (over us). So the brain, in which we participate as members, is indeed the Corpus Christi, since specifically it breaks this deterministic blind lower level power. {Illustration: A circle divided in four parts marked "Present", "1974", "Past" and "45". An arrow "Alive" points to the "Present" part and an arrow "Next World" points to the "Past" part.} The mystical body of Christ spans the past + the present; this world + the next. Its intervention in US history in 1974 is a supreme example of its plenary power to overrule the forces of this lower realm. I may not have understood this before. Here is an enormous override. 2/2 MU7-7491 Ralph __ What if the "upper realm" is the post mortem realm? This would fit in with the popular concept of heaven. But the brain, by participating in both realms, spanning both, would bring to its living members post mortem experiences: they would pass across + yet at the same time still be here. They would be in 2 realms at once. This is exactly what I experienced. Also, for someone dead +
